_about: Embraer 175-E2, from APM 5824 Rev 25 (Nov 29/24; Section 02 Aug 05/22) Figure 2.3 General Aircraft Dimensions (page index 21): side, plan and front views on one sheet, black lines over a pale yellow fill (layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill). The side and plan are drawn to one scale (the printed 32.37 m length, 9.22 m tailplane span and 17.63 m nose-to-wing-tip figure agree to 0.1%), at 0.9408 of the E190-E2's figure; the front view is drawn 1.2003 times larger (its 31.39 m span's and 6.04 m track's extension lines), so it is rendered at scale 13.33 to the side's. Scaled by the printed 32.37 m overall length (2.2.8: 32.366 m). The E190-E2's (e290/) points moved by two fuselage plugs taken out (plug.py: 2.21 m ahead of the wing, from the wheelbases, 12.77 m against 10.56 m, the 4.55 m nose gear and 6.82 m forward cargo door figures being the same; 1.75 m behind it, the rest of the 3.96 m), then snapped to this sheet; its own wing, tailplane, fin and PW1700G nacelle placed here. The figure prints 19.67 m to the aft cargo door where it draws it at 20.66 m (and the E190-E2's 24.57 m at 24.66 m): the drawing agrees with its length, wheelbase and the plugs, so the door is as drawn. The figure's tailplane span is 9.22 m (2.2.10 prints 9.07 m). Pixels of layers.py rasters at scale 16 (the front at 13.33), line centres. Windows joined to other lines (one to the 6.82 m dimension's extension line, four to the wing's) are placed at their drawn centres (windowsAlso). The cargo doors are on the right, as on the other E-Jets (Figure 2.4). The cockpit panes are the E190-E2's, moved by the same scale (the nose is the same).

sources.title: Embraer, E-Jets E2 Airport Planning Manual (APM 5824 Rev 25, Nov 29/24), Section 02, Figure 2.3 General Aircraft Dimensions (E175-E2); 2.2.3 and 2.2.8 dimensions; Figure 2.21 cabin cross-section
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/e275/), starting from the E190-E2's placed points less two fuselage plugs; the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The figure prints 19.67 m from the nose to the aft cargo door but draws it at 20.66 m, in agreement with its own length and wheelbase: the shape keeps the drawing's.
